spec_match.rationale: Builds the codec string with the §6.3 field structure (3-digit 0-255 profiles, closed substream-codec vocabulary incl. mp4a.40.2 continuation) and sends a real MediaCapabilities AudioConfiguration with channels/samplerate/bitrate/spatialRendering.

interactive.rationale: Eight live fields rebuild and revalidate the string on every input; the query button calls the real navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo and paints the returned supported/smooth/powerEfficient booleans plus the full config and answer JSON.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises varying codec parameter fields with real supported/smooth/powerEfficient answers; delivered, including a deliberately-invalid vorbis option.

edge_cases.rationale: Grammar violations (256, one-digit via text entry, vorbis) are explained locally, then still sent so the API's real rejection/false is shown; missing-mediaCapabilities and TypeError branches have distinct honest messages; three telemetry branches are separated.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5113656292540416, IAMF §6.3, and the Media Capabilities AudioConfiguration section.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's async decodingInfo assertion and the three negative grammar assertions cover this page's contract; positive assertion fails honestly on non-IAMF browsers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP autorun on desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3: grammar OK line rendered, query resolved supported:false with the honest-negative note, badges painted false, zero console errors (only the environmental fonts stylesheet failure). supported:true could not be observed — no IAMF decoder in this sandbox.

telemetry_health.rationale: Distinct asserts for supported, invalid-rejected, unsupported-fallback, API-missing, and unexpected rejection; the fallback is never a pass.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; grammar-OK text switched from emerald (4.01:1, fails AA) to black with an emerald >=3:1 glyph; result badges use 1.25rem bold (large text) so emerald/rose backgrounds with ivory text pass at 3:1.

accessibility.rationale: Every field is a native labelled input/select/checkbox with 44px min height and focus-visible outline; built string, grammar verdict, badges, and result are aria-live polite; AT-tree inspection deferred (no MCP in sandbox).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: auto-fit minmax grid stacks fields on 360x740 DPR3 with no horizontal overflow (CDP scrollWidth==innerWidth both classes); JSON output wraps with overflow-wrap:anywhere.

openQuestions.title: Record real smooth/powerEfficient values on IAMF-enabled Chrome
openQuestions.detail: On a decoder-enabled Chrome 152 build, query across profiles, substream codecs, and channel counts (2 vs 12 for 7.1.4) and record how smooth/powerEfficient respond, plus whether spatialRendering:true changes supported.

openQuestions.title: Check type:'file' vs 'media-source' divergence for IAMF
openQuestions.detail: The chromestatus summary scopes the feature to MSE. Once shipped, verify whether decodingInfo with type:'file' answers differently from 'media-source' for the same IAMF configuration and surface the difference on the page if so.

guidanceConsulted.query: media playback progress loading error retry states accessible live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native form controls with real labels; announce state changes via polite live regions; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All eight fields are native labelled controls; built string, grammar verdict, badge row, and result output carry aria-live polite; focus-visible outlines on every control.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive results table readout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic auto-fit grid tracks so control panels reflow without breakpoints or overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(9.5rem,1fr)); verified zero horizontal overflow at 360px via CDP metrics.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: cdp-check METRICS overflow:false at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800

summary: The playground assembles and validates the exact IAMF codecs parameter the way Chrome's parser does, then shows the real Media Capabilities booleans. Verified on both viewport classes in headless Chromium 141 with the honest supported:false negative; real positive values await an IAMF-enabled build.
